raw_caption: On September 25th - 2026, Shakarganj Foundation distributed 10 ltr of Cooking Oil snf 15 Soap bars to Sweet Home - Jhang.Bananas and Mango Refresh Juice packets were also distributed among Students and Staff members.Donating to a Children's Home profoundly impacts the lives of children by improving access to basic needs such as food, shelter, and healthcare. By providing these essential items, we empower them to flourish and reach their full potential. Shakarganj Foundation remains committed to supporting Sweet Homes as part of our Social Action Program.
